  • 25. Āpattibhayavagga 25. Perils of Offenses

Dutiyavohārasutta Expressions (2nd)

“Cattārome, bhikkhave, ariyavohārā. “Mendicants, there are these four noble expressions. Katame cattāro? What four? Adiṭṭhe adiṭṭhavāditā, asute asutavāditā, amute amutavāditā, aviññāte aviññātavāditā—Saying you haven’t seen, heard, thought, or known something, and you haven’t. Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro ariyavohārā”ti. These are the four noble expressions.”

Navamaṁ.
